evidence_limit: Finite checks of the explicitly listed families and boundary examples only; not an exhaustive original-graph search, not Lean verification, and not a substitute for the Stage 2 and Stage 3 paper proofs.

triangle_roots.scope: One internal label edge, every capacity-feasible multiset of zero through five double tips, and separate branch completion; no additional original tip-to-tip edges in this check.

saturated_families.scope: All capacity-feasible type multisets in the two stated saturated families, with all simple original graphs on their tips having at least three edges and respecting original degree four; all nineteen-edge core candidate sets containing the four root edges. Spare core degree is completed by separate branches. Tip permutations are represented by nondecreasing type multisets; root labels remain labelled.
